title: Chronology of Indian‑origin astronauts
subject: History
caption: Chronological timeline of Indian‑origin astronauts and their selection and flight milestones
altText: A timeline displaying eight events in chronological order: in 1984 Rakesh Sharma was selected and later flew on Soyuz T‑11; in 1997 Kalpana Chawla was selected and later flew on STS‑87; in 2006 Sunita Williams was selected and later flew on STS‑116; in 2021 Sirisha Bandla was selected and later flew on Blue Origin NS‑21.
